lines.text: Many learners say: I have two brother.
Add s when there are two or more.

data.why: Add s when there are two or more.

native.tip: 2つ以上の数のときは名詞に s をつけます。two brothers です。
native.caption: “I have two brother.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語は「兄弟が二人」のように名詞の形が変わらないので、s が抜けがちです。“I have two brothers.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“brothers”。“I have two brothers.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Add s after two: two brothers.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I have two brother.” 😅 Japanese nouns do not change for more than one, so the s is easy to drop. The natural way is “I have two brothers.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
